scope: Static, local-only pre-optimizer audit of the fresh recovery branch. No corpus rows, sealed/native-final data, MCP, Drive, browser, or GPU were accessed. No active code was changed.

owner_budget.note: The preparation note contains an older 1500-second reserve; its structured scope_update and current owner_run_scope supersede it with 600 seconds.

configuration_review.precision: FP16 forward autocast with CUDA GradScaler; NF4 double quant base

objective_review.ignored_positions: labels == -100 excluded before CE; no model-side labels passed to forward
objective_review.row_weighting: Unreduced CE on selected target tokens; token CE averaged per row; row means averaged within each microbatch and multiplied by microbatch_rows/effective_batch_rows before accumulation. This gives equal row weight across a full effective batch and up to 16 rows at the terminal partial batch.
objective_review.gradient_scaling: FP16 GradScaler spans microbatch backward calls; unscale once before global norm clipping and optimizer step. Scale decrease after update is treated as a skipped step and fails closed.
objective_review.first_microbatch_audit: Compares selected-token vectorized CE against an explicit per-row reference at first microbatch; fails if absolute difference exceeds 1e-6.
objective_review.static_conclusion: No loss-shift, mask, row-weight, accumulation, gradient-scaling, or LoRA target inconsistency found.

preflight.coverage: Synthetic sampling-plan dedup/worked-row retention, 30-fixture review-gate validation, selected-token CE value and gradient equivalence, and zero gradient at ignored positions. CPU-only; no corpus.

blockers_before_optimizer_update: Worker waits for pretrain_qa_approved.json and rejects approval unless it binds the exact current source_plan_sha256 and renderer_sha256, asserts actual source samples were reviewed, and human_review_claimed=false. Do not approve optimizer updates until that exact cloud-projected source QA evidence and owner authorization are present.
This branch is fresh-base only and must retain the 600-second evaluation/publication reserve; inherited adapter/checkpoint resume is rejected.
risk_notes: The stronger r16/alpha16 and 2e-5 LR are a hypothesis with increased regression risk; only the strict 30-pair development gate can establish eligibility.
The 30-item development set is reused from prior development and is not an unseen final benchmark.
